answer: The lagoon index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the mesa queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 165 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the knoll. A 438 account operation therefore ties up 6 million dollars of idle capital. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
